reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness Web UI enhancement that hides intermediate thinking and tool-call rows while retaining final replies, live status, and optionally expandable turn traces.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供“只看结果”界面开关，隐藏思考与工具调用过程并保留实时状态和可展开的回合痕迹。
summaries.en: Adds a results-only toggle to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that hides thinking and tool-call details while retaining live status and expandable turn traces.

capabilities: Changes conversation presentation by hiding or revealing process rows
Adds a results-only toggle and configurable turn trace in the web interface
Reads and writes localStorage for user preferences
Observes conversation DOM mutations to maintain live status display
